title: Duplicate Control and Daily History Rules

policy_amendment.authority_scope: User-authorized methodology and internal contract amendment only; no content approval, public activation or execution authorization.
policy_amendment.scope: Canonical publication day, unused-first precedence and immutable assignment/history requirements within AG70D v2. Linguistic, etymological, evidence and editorial approval rules are unchanged.

duplicate_check_order: exact canonical lexical identity and historical selected_word_id aliases
reviewed lemma/surface-form identity links and fallback_bank_record_id if applicable
reviewed semantic equivalence links; unresolved identity/equivalence records are excluded
complete publication history and active reservation/assignment conflicts
compatible theme/repeat_control_tags within an explicitly approved repeat window
legacy_replacement_rule: If selected word was already published within the repeat-control window, select the next eligible approved candidate. If all candidates are repeated, choose least-recent eligible word and mark repeat_pressure=true.
replacement_rule: From the approved context-eligible pool, select only never-before-published canonical lexical identities after reviewed identity/equivalence and reservation checks. Apply compatible repeat-window exclusions and approved deterministic precedence within that unused pool. Withhold when no unused eligible identity remains; no automatic least-recent reuse or fabricated fallback is authorized.

publication_model.canonical_context_requirement: A separately reviewed, versioned editorial Panchang/context basis must be fixed for the global publication scope. No default place or sunrise cutoff is invented by this amendment; missing approval withholds selection.

precedence_requirement: Consume separately approved deterministic relevance, quality and editorial precedence rules. Missing rules, unresolved ties or caller order must not become an arbitrary ranking; no random choice is allowed.

exhaustion_policy.editorial_monitoring: Record the canonical date, policy/context/bank/history versions, exclusion counts and exact withheld reason in a non-public audit event; no assignment or publication is fabricated.
exhaustion_policy.repeat_window_role: Additional approved exclusions only; never a substitute for complete history or permission to reuse a published identity/equivalent.

history_contract.contract_role: Additive AG70D requirements for a future writer using existing history banks; not a populated bank, migration or executable persistence owner.

state_rules.draft_reservation: Non-public concurrency claim only; not approval or publication. Cancellation/expiry requires its own auditable event.
state_rules.approved_assignment: Unique, immutable canonical date/identity/version snapshot after all assignment gates; never regenerated because the bank grows.
state_rules.published: Separate immutable event after publication permission checks; only this and valid corrective publication count as actual published usage.
state_rules.corrective_publication: Requires separate explicit correction approval and a reference to the original publication; preserves both payloads and history. Not a fresh daily assignment or reuse-policy bypass.
state_rules.withheld: Reason-bearing non-public audit event; must not masquerade as an assignment or a published word.

history_contract.same_date_race_handling: Only one atomic date/identity claim succeeds; a stale revision must retry from complete history and replay the existing assignment or report a pending reservation.
history_contract.bank_additions: Newly approved versions may enter future unassigned dates only; never rerank existing assignments or regenerate old history.

scope_reconciliation.prior: Date plus unspecified location context could be read as user-local selection.
scope_reconciliation.now: Canonical IST publication date and separately approved fixed editorial context; requesting location does not choose the word.

scope_reconciliation.prior: Repeat-window expiry and least-recent replacement could permit repetition while unused identities exist.
scope_reconciliation.now: Complete-history unused-first protection takes precedence; initial exhaustion withholds. The exact former clause is retained as legacy_replacement_rule.

scope_reconciliation.prior: Base fields describe date/location/context but omit explicit publication timezone, immutable versions and event separation.
scope_reconciliation.now: This AG70D history contract supplies additive requirements; existing AG70E bank structures and legacy history schema remain untouched.

scope_reconciliation.prior: Generic scope/timezone and pending unused-first proposal documented a governance gap.
scope_reconciliation.now: This amendment governs canonical scope and withholding; historical F3B-2/3/4 findings and proposed contracts remain unmodified archival evidence.

scale_contract.note: Existing normalized AG70E arrays and reusable evidence IDs support growth structurally; no performance or production content qualification is claimed.
